rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a baby's shake-to-make-noise toy.

example.english: The baby grins from ear to ear whenever they shake the rattle.
example.traditional: 個嬰兒一搖手上嘅搖鈴，就笑到見牙唔見眼。
example.jyutping: go3 jing1 ji4 jat1 jiu4 sau2 soeng5 ge3 jiu4 ling4 zau6 siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this for the repeated clicking or rattling noise made by loose or vibrating objects, such as something under a dashboard.

example.english: A rattle keeps coming from under the steering wheel; I wonder if a part has come loose.
example.traditional: 架車個軚盤下面成日傳出格格聲，唔知係咪有零件鬆咗。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 go3 taai5 pun4 haa6 min6 seng4 jat6 cyun4 ceot1 gaak3 gaak3 sing1 m4 zi1 hai6 mai6 jau5 ling4 gin6 sung1 zo2

rows.jyutping: hoeng2 mei5 se4 mei5 baa1 ge3 hoeng2 waan4
rows.note: Use this specifically for the sound-making rings at the end of a rattlesnake's tail.

example.english: The rattlesnake's tail rings make a rattle whenever it moves.
example.traditional: 響尾蛇尾巴嘅響環一郁，就響個不停。
example.jyutping: hoeng2 mei5 se4 mei5 baa1 ge3 hoeng2 waan4 jat1 juk1 zau6 hoeng2 go3 bat1 ting4
